review:
Rainbow Princess is a sparkling cluster slot with Super Cascades and Magic Frame Multipliers. Whenever there's a winning cluster, frames can appear on random positions during a spin or cascade, each holding an adding multiplier that applies to any cluster passing through it.

Several frames in the same cluster add together before multiplying the win, so a big cluster crossing two or three frames is the main goal. The values start at 2x and climb from there, and the maximum is 10,000x. The gem-and-stardust art is very polished.
